title: Wonky Shape
text: Wonky Shape. Interesting. I got a plate to review last week from this same set and manufacturer. I was 5 star impressed. This bowl, not so much. It isn't round and it is very wavy. It may be by design to look handmade, but in any event the shape is kind of odd and strange. Seems well made, just looks really wonky.
